title: Desktop first-run: Connect now on the AI-account step turns the step Done in place (browser and device sign-ins)
steps: S1: run the tracy-onboard mount/flow/render tests and the tracy-model-plan connect tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake seat-plan doors).
S2: the end-to-end form of this case is ST-6 in tests/acceptance/desktop-onboard-v2 (app from source on a stand, Copilot device flow faked at the seat-plan doors).
expect: stepsDone: the AI step is done exactly when an account is connected.
Connect now: the caught callback connects and the step turns Done without closing the screen; a device sign-in shows the code, polls, then answers the status.
The connect panel shows idle (Connect now), pending (browser/device) and connected states; no connected account leaves the step not done.

tests: Connect now: the vendor page opens through the app
no connected account: the AI step is not done
the Done / Not done chip and the checklist follow each step
a device sign-in shows the code, polls until confirmed

fence: the AI step's Done is derived from the seat-plan status a connect answers, not from a click
